The application boots cleanly on port 4000 and serves correctly (the readiness marker is applied in-browser once the UI loads). I've freed the port so the review environment can launch it.

I'm now in **Phase 4 (Acceptance)**. Here's my report.

---

## The bookmarks app is built and verified

**Where to use it:** **http://maker:4000**

This is the real application (not the prototype) — fresh production code, with your bookmarks stored privately in your own browser so they persist between visits.

**Verification outcome — everything passed:**
- **24 scenario-based acceptance tests**, driving a real browser, covering all 12 approved flows — every one green.
- **30 internal unit tests** on the search language, note formatting, link handling, and page-detail parsing — all green.
- A live end-to-end check confirmed real page details are fetched (it pulled a real page title), failed fetches still save the link, and internal/private addresses are refused for safety.

**What's working, in your terms:**
- Save a link → its title, description, icon, and preview image fill in automatically; a failed or unreachable page still saves with a warning, retry, and manual editing.
- Saving a link you already have doesn't duplicate it — it takes you to the existing one (archived ones too).
- Correct the title, description, or the link itself, with an optional "re-fetch details."
- Organize with reusable tags and a private, formatted note.
- Find things with the full search language (case-insensitive, `"phrases"`, `#tag`, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, parentheses) and tag filters that narrow and combine.
- A separate **Read Later** list (a marker), and **Archive** to set links aside out of your main view and searches, retained and restorable.
- Tidy cards for awkward content, self-explaining empty screens, and your whole collection persisting privately between visits.

Cross-device syncing remains recorded for a later round.

---

Please open **http://maker:4000** and try it as you would in real use. **Do you accept this software as your first version, on the basis of the behaviour we approved together and this verification report?**
